lines.text: This is the third time I am coming, and I already warned them on my second visit.
Christ was crucified in weakness, yet lives by God's power, and is powerful among them.
I write while absent so I need not be severe with the authority the Lord gave me to collect the gift for Jerusalem.

wrong_details.wrong: to collect the gift for Jerusalem

lines.text: Brothers are told to live in peace, greet one another with a holy kiss, and the letter ends with the Spirit's fellowship.
